name: Mofu x Mokyu ~Goshujin-sama no Osewa Shimasu~
original_name: もふ×もきゅ～ご主人様のお世話します～
source:
Main character comes to Tokyo and manages to enter a university. His parents want to see him back, so they cut the funding. Protagonist is desperate to find a part time job when a girl in maid outfit jumps out before him. She calls him "master" and claims that she comes from future to take care of him.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-may-2004-carnival.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公来到东京并成功考入大学。父母希望他回家，于是切断了经济援助。就在主人公为寻找兼职焦头烂额时，一名身穿女仆装的女孩突然跳到他面前。她称他为‘主人’，并声称自己来自未来，是来照顾他的。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-may-2004-carnival.html]vndbreview[/url]]
